notes: Make it fun is a group-chat voice: every option is a first-person action a real person would text word for word, with the humor carried by one true, specific detail (the grocery run, instant noodles for a week, a week in my cart, the notes app is full, someone actually likes vacuuming) and never by a metaphor. Option order and levels follow bank.js exactly, including the out-of-order celebration_budget scene and the none-on-this-tag options for fairness_rule and risk_style. To avoid a cool answer, each pole gets a matching amount of charm, and the healthy-looking option gets its own small confession rather than a halo. Emotion-coded options keep their private feeling in plain words (felt bad about it, I'd only ordered a salad, still think about the other, wondered if they were mad at me). Scenes keep last-time framing; only quick takes and sealed checks use imagined moments. Everything is gender neutral and teen-safe except the three 18+ tags plus the existing adult-only commitment_pace. Each tag is masked behind the everyday moment. Options start with different words so they scan fast, and there are no em dashes.
